question: Faqir Chand Kohli, who passed away in November 2020, was known as the ‘_____’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Father of Indian Software (IT) Industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Faqir Chand Kohli, known as the father of Indian Software Industry, passed away in November 2020.
 
• Mr Kohli was the founder-CEO of TCS.__
 
• He joined Tata Electric Co. in 1951 where he helped set up the load dispatching system to manage system operations.
 
• He became director of Tata Electric in 1970.
 
• He pioneered India’s IT revolution and helped the country build the $190-billion IT industry.
